name: dimensional-switch-slider
title: Dimensional Switch Slider
description: A 3D card-flip carousel with directional text transitions, configurable horizontal/vertical flip axis, custom easing, and pagination.

props.name: infinite
props.description: Wraps from the last item back to the first (and vice versa) instead of clamping and disabling the prev/next buttons at the ends.

props.name: direction
props.description: Axis the card flips around - horizontal flips on Y with text sliding/tilting left-right, vertical flips on X with text sliding/tilting up-down.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Automatically advances to the next slide on a timer.

props.name: autoplayDelay
props.description: Time between automatic slide changes in milliseconds.

props.name: ease
props.description: CSS cubic-bezier(...) string or a plain GSAP ease name - drives the card flip and both text tweens.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Color applied to the slide text.

props.name: textSize
props.description: Font size of the slide text. Numbers are treated as pixels; strings can use any CSS length.

props.name: cardWidth
props.description: Width of the card. Numbers are treated as pixels; strings can use any CSS length.

props.name: cardHeight
props.description: Height of the card. Numbers are treated as pixels; strings can use any CSS length.

props.name: cardBorderRadius
props.description: Border radius applied to both card faces. Numbers are treated as pixels; strings can use any CSS length.

props.name: cardClassName
props.description: Extra classes appended to the card's own wrapper div.
